arabic_text: إلهِي أَحْمَـدُكَ ـ وَأَنْتَ لِلْحَمْدِ أَهْلٌ ـ عَلَى حُسْنِ صَنِيعِكَ إلَيَّ، وَسُبُـوغِ نَعْمَآئِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَجَزِيْلِ عَطَآئِكَ عِنْدِي، وَعَلَى ما فَضَّلْتَنِي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ،
transliteration: ilāhī aḥmaduka waanta li-l-ḥamdi ahlu ʿalā ḥusni ṣanīʿika ilayya, wa subūgh naʿmāʾika ʿalayya wajazīli ʿataāʾika ʿindī wa ʿalā mā faḍḍaltanī min raḥmatika
english_text: My God, I praise Thee, - and Thou art worthy of praise - for Thy benefaction toward me, the lavishness of Thy favours toward me, and Thy plentiful bestowal upon me, and for showing bounty toward me through Thy mercy

arabic_text: وَأَسْبَغْتَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ نِعْمَتِكَ،
transliteration: wa-asbaghta ʿalayya min niʿmatika
english_text: and lavishing Thy favour upon me.

arabic_text: فَقَدِ اصْطَنَعْتَ عِنْدِي ما يَعْجِزُ عَنُهُ شُكْرِي، وَلَوْلاَ إحْسَانُكَ، إلَيَّ وَسُبُوغُ نَعْمَآئِـكَ عَلَيَّ مَا بَلَغْتُ إحْرازَ حَظِّي، وَلاَ إصْلاَحَ نَفْسِي، وَلكِنَّكَ ابْتَدَأْتَنِي بِالإحْسَانِ،
transliteration: faqadisṭanaʿta ʿindī mā yaʿjizu ʿanuhu shukrī, walawlā iḥsānuka, ʾil wa subuughu naʿmaa'ika ʿalayya mā balaghtu iḥrāza ḥaẓẓī, walā iṣlāḥa nafsī walakinna-ka abtada'tani bil-ihsan
english_text: Thou hast done well toward me and I am incapable of thanking Thee. Were it not for Thy beneficence toward me and the lavishness of Thy favours upon me, I would not have reached the taking of my share nor would my soul have been set right, but Thou began with beneficence toward me,

arabic_text: وَرَزَقْتَنِي فِي أُمُورِي كُلِّهَا الْكِفَايَةَ، وَصَرَفْتَ عَنِّي جَهْدَ الْبَلاءِ، وَمَنَعْتَ مِنِّي مَحْذُورَ الْقَضَآءِ
transliteration: wa razaqtanī fī umūrī kullihā al-kifāyah waṣarafata ʿannī jahd al-balāʾi wa manʿta minni maḥḏūra al-qaḍāʾ
english_text: provided me sufficiency in all my affairs, turned away from me the toil of affliction, and held back from me the feared decree.

arabic_text: إلهِي فَكَمْ مِنْ بَلاء جَاهِد قَدْ صَرَفْتَ عَنِّي،
transliteration: ilāhī fakam min balā'in jāhid qad ṣarafata ʿannī
english_text: My God, how many a toilsome affliction which Thou hast turned away from me!

arabic_text: وَكَمْ مِنْ نِعْمَة سَابِغَة أَقْرَرْتَ بِهَا عَيْنِي،
transliteration: wa kam min niʿmatin sābighah aqarrarta bihā ʿayni
english_text: How many a lavish favour with which Thou hast gladdened my eye!

arabic_text: وَكَمْ مِنْ صَنِيعَة كَرِيمَة لَكَ عِنْدِي.
transliteration: wa kam min ṣanīʿa kareema lak āndi
english_text: How many a generous benefaction of Thine which is present with me!

arabic_text: أَنْتَ الَّذِي أَجَبْتَ عِنْدَ الاضْطِرَارِ دَعْوَتِي، وَأَقَلْتَ عِنْدَ الْعِثَارِ زَلَّتِي، وَأَخَذْتَ لِي مِنَ الاَعْدَآءِ بِظُلاَمَتِي.
transliteration: anta alladhī ʾajabta ʿinda al-iḍṭirār ḍaʿwatī wa-aqalta 'indal-'ithaari zal-latii wa'akhadhta li mina al-a'daa'i bi dhulamati
english_text: It is Thou who responded to my supplication at the time of distress, released me from my slip in stumbling, and took my enemies to task for doing wrong to me.

arabic_text: إلهِي مَا وَجَدْتُكَ بَخِيلاً حِينَ سَأَلْتُكَ، وَلاَ مُنْقَبِضاً حِينَ أَرَدْتُكَ،
transliteration: 'ilāhī mā wajadtu-ka bakheelan hīna sa'al-tuka wa lā munqabidaan hīna aradtu-ka
english_text: My God, I did not find Thee a miser when I asked of Thee nor a withholder when I desired from Thee.

arabic_text: بل وَجَدْتُكَ لِدُعَآئِي سَامِعاً، وَلِمَطَالِبِي مُعْطِياً،
transliteration: bal wajadtu-ka li-du'aa-i saami'an, wa limataalibi mu'ti'an
english_text: No, 1 found Thee a hearer of my supplication and a bestower of my requests;

arabic_text: وَوَجَدْتُ نُعْمَاكَ عَلَيَّ سَابِغَةً، فِي كُلِّ شَأْن مِنْ شَأْنِي، وَكُلِّ زَمَان مِنْ زَمَانِي،
transliteration: wa wajadtu nuʿmāka ʿalayya sābighatan fī kulli shaʾnin min shaʾnī, wa kulli zamānin min zamānī
english_text: I found Thy favours toward me lavish in my every situation and in my every time.

arabic_text: فَأَنْتَ عِنْدِي مَحْمُودٌ، وَصَنِيعُكَ لَدَيَّ مَبْرُورٌ،
transliteration: faanta ʿindee mahmoodun, waṣanineeka ladayya mabroorun
english_text: So Thou art praised by me and Thy benefaction honoured.

arabic_text: تَحْمَدُكَ نَفْسِي وَلِسَانِيْ وَعَقْلِي حَمْداً يَبْلُغُ الوَفَآءَ وَحَقِيقَةَ الشُّكْرِ، حَمْداً يَكُونُ مَبْلَغَ رِضَاكَ عَنِّي، فَنَجِّنِي مِنْ سَخَطِكَ يَا كَهْفِي حِينَ تُعْيينِي الْمَذَاهِبُ،
transliteration: taḥmaduka nafsī wa lisānī wa ʿaqlī ḥamdan yabluġu al-wafāʾa wa ḥaqīqata al-shuk ḥamdan yakūnu mablagha riḍāka ʿannī fanağğinī min sakhaṭika yā kahfī ḥīna tuʿyīnī al-maẓāhibu
english_text: My soul, my tongue, and my intelligence praise Thee, a praise that reaches fulfilment and the reality of thanksgiving, a praise that attains to Thy good pleasure with me - so deliver me from Thy displeasure! O my cave when the ways thwart me!

arabic_text: وَيَا مُقيلِي عَثْرَتِي،
transliteration: wa yā muqīlī ʿathratī
english_text: O He who releases me from my stumble!

arabic_text: فَلَوْلاَ سَتْرُكَ عَوْرَتِي لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمَفْضُوحِينَ،
transliteration: falawla sātruka ʿawratī lakuntu min al-mafḍūḥīn
english_text: Were it not for Thy covering my shameful defects, I would be one of the disgraced.

arabic_text: وَيَا مُؤَيِّدِي بِالنَّصْرِ،
transliteration: wa yā muʾayyadī bil-naṣr
english_text: O my confirmer through help!

arabic_text: فَلَوْلاَ نَصْرُكَ إيَّايَ لَكُنْتُ مِنَ الْمَغْلُوبِينَ،
transliteration: falawlā naṣrukā ʾiyyāya lakuntu min al-maghloobīn
english_text: Were it not for Thy helping me, I would be one of the overcome!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ وَضَعَتْ لَهُ الْمُلُوكُ نِيرَ الْمَذَلَّةِ عَلى أَعْنَاقِهَا، فَهُمْ مِنْ سَطَواتِهِ خَائِفُونَ، وَيَا أَهْلَ التَّقْوَى،
transliteration: wa yā man waḍaʿat lahul mulūku nīra al-maẓallati ʿalā aʿnāqihā fahum min satawatihi kha'ifun, wa ya ahl al-taqwa
english_text: O He before whom kings place the yoke of lowliness around their necks, fearing His penalties! O worthy of reverent fear!

arabic_text: وَيَا مَنْ لَهُ الأَسْمَآءُ الْحُسْنى أَسْأَلُكَ أَنْ تَعْفُوَ عَنِّي، وَتَغْفِرَ لِي فَلَسْتُ، بَرِيئاً فَأَعْتَذِرَ، وَلاَ بِذِي قُوَّة فَأَنْتَصِرَ، وَلاَ مَفَرَّ لِي فَأَفِرَّ. وَأَسْتَقِيْلُكَ عَثَراتِي،
transliteration: wayā man lahul asma'ul husnā as'aluka an ta'fuwa 'anni wa taghfir li fa lam astu, bari'an fa a'thira walā bi dhī quwwah fa'antassir wa lā mafarr li faʾafr." "wa astaqīluka ʿatharātī
english_text: O He to whom belong the names most beautiful! I ask Thee to pardon me and to forgive me, for I am not innocent that I should offer excuses, nor a possessor of strength that I should gain victory, nor have I any place of flight that I should flee! I ask Thee to release me from my stumbles,

arabic_text: وَأَتَنَصَّلُ إلَيْكَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي الَّتِي قَدْ أَوْبَقَتْنِي، وَأَحَاطَتْ بِي فَأَهْلَكَتْنِي،
transliteration: wa-atanassalu ilaika min dhunubiyya allati qad awbaqatni wa-ahat biy fa-ahlaqatni
english_text: and before Thee I disavow my sins, which have laid me waste, encompassed me, and destroyed me!

arabic_text: مِنْهَا فَرَرْتُ إلَيْكَ رَبِّ تَائِباً، فَتُبْ عَلَيَّ مُتَعَوِّذاً، فَأَعِذْنِي مُسْتَجِيراً، فَلاَ تَخْذُلْنِي سَآئِلاً، فَلاَ تَحْرِمْنِي مُعْتَصِماً، فَلاَ تُسْلِمْنِي دَاعِياً، فَلاَ تَرُدَّنِي خَائِباً،
transliteration: minhā farartu ʾilayka rabbi tāʾiban fatabba ʿalayya mutaʿawwizan, fa'aʾidhni mustajiran fala taḫẓulnī sāʾilan, fala taḥrimnī muʿtaṣiman fala tusallimnī dāʿiyan, fala taruddanī khāʾiban
english_text: I flee from them to Thee, my Lord, turning repentantly, so turn toward me, seeking refuge, so grant me refuge, asking sanctuary, so abandon me not, requesting, so deprive me not, holding fast, so leave me not, supplicating, so send me not back disappointed!

arabic_text: دَعوْتُكَ يَارَبِّ مِسْكِيناً، مُسْتَكِيناً، مُشْفِقاً، خَائِفاً، وَجِلاً، فَقِيراً، مُضْطَرّاً، إلَيْكَ
transliteration: daʿawtu-ka yā rabbī, mis-kīnan, mustakīnan mushfiqan, kha'ifan, wajilan, faqiran, mudtarran, ilayka
english_text: I have supplicated Thee, my Lord, as one miserable, abased, apprehensive, fearful, quaking, poor, driven to have recourse to Thee!

arabic_text: أَشْكُو إلَيْكَ يَا إلهِي ضَعْفَ نَفْسِي عَنِ الْمُسَارَعَةِ فِيمَا وَعَدْتَهُ أَوْلِيَآءَكَ، وَالْمُجَانَبَةِ عَمَّا حَذَّرْتَهُ أَعْدَآءَكَ، وَكَثْرَةَ هُمُومِي وَوَسْوَسَةَ نَفْسِي .
transliteration: ashku ilayka ya ilahi da'fanafsi ʿanil musāraʿati fīmā waʿadtahu ʾawliyāʾaka wal-mujānabati ʿammā ḥaḏḏartahū ʾaʿdāʾaka wa kathrat humoomi wa waswasat nafsi
english_text: I complain to Thee, my God, of my soul - which is too weak to hurry to that which Thou hast promised Thy friends or to avoid that against which Thou hast cautioned Thy enemies - and of the multitude of my concerns, and of my soul's confusing thoughts.

arabic_text: إلهِي لَمْ تَفْضَحْنِي بِسَرِيرَتِي، وَلَمْ تُهْلِكْنِي بِجَرِيرَتِي، أَدْعُوكَ فَتُجِيبُنِي وَإنْ كُنْتُ بَطِيئاً حِيْنَ تَدْعُونِي.
transliteration: ilāhī lam tafḍaḥnī bi-sarīrati walaml tuhlīkni bi-jarīratī, ad'ūka fatujībunī wa-in kuntu baṭi'an hinna tadʿūnī
english_text: My God, Thou hast not disgraced me through my secret thoughts or destroyed me because of my misdeeds! I call upon Thee, and Thou respondest, even if I am slow when Thou callest upon me.

arabic_text: وَأَسْأَلُكَ كُلَّمَا شِئْتُ مِنْ حَوَائِجِي، وَحَيْثُ مَا كُنْتُ وَضَعْتُ عِنْدَكَ سِرِّي،
transliteration: wa as'aluka kullama shi'tu min hawaa'iji wa ḥaythu mā kuntu waḍaʿtu ʿindaka sirrī
english_text: I ask Thee everything I want of my needs, and I deposit with Thee my secret wherever I may be.

arabic_text: فَلاَ أَدْعُو سِوَاكَ، وَلاَ أَرْجُو غَيْرَكَ،
transliteration: fala adʿu siwaka, wa la arju ghayraka
english_text: I supplicate no one besides Thee, and I hope for no one other than Thee.

arabic_text: لَبَّيْكَ لَبَّيْكَ، تَسْمَعُ مَنْ شَكَا إلَيْكَ،
transliteration: labbaika labbaika, tasmaʿu man shaka ʾilayka
english_text: At Thy service! At Thy service! Thou hearest him who complains to Thee!

arabic_text: وَتَلْقى مَنْ تَوَكَّلَ عَلَيْكَ،
transliteration: wa talqā man tawakkala ʿalayk
english_text: Thou receivest him who has confidence in Thee!

arabic_text: وَتُخَلِّصُ مَنِ اعْتَصَمَ بِكَ،
transliteration: wa tukhalliṣu mani ʿtaṣama bi-ka
english_text: Thou savest him who holds fast to Thee!

arabic_text: وَتُفَرِّجُ عَمَّنْ لاذَ بِكَ.
transliteration: wa tufarriju ʿamman ladh bi-ka
english_text: Thou givest relief to him who seeks shelter in Thee!
